Jordan Morales: Heads-up  I converted my IC (contractor) Sasha to full-time on Dec 15. She had 8 days PTO as a contractor (per contract) and weve already booked Dec 28-29 for family travel. With the year-end blackout Dec 27-31, how do we handle accrual proration / carryover for converted hires? Do those contractor days convert or get paid out?
Aisha (People Ops): Congrats on the conversion! Short answer: PTO treatment depends on the conversion policy and effective date. For mid-month/year conversions we prorate accruals from the FT start date. Contract-only PTO does not automatically convert unless the offer letter or conversion terms specify. We can either: 1) honor an employer-paid payout for unused contractor PTO (one-time payout), or 2) allow an exception to mark the booked Dec 28-29 as "Conversion Accommodation" so they don't lose those days despite the blackout. Manager approval required.
Jordan Morales: The offer letter stated a one-time transition credit of 5 days to the PTO balance at conversion. Sasha still has 3 contractor days left beyond that. Shes hoping to use Dec 28-29 as PTO, not unpaid.
Priya (People Ops): With that transition credit we should be able to cover Dec 28-29 using the 5-day credit. For the additional 3 contractor days, Payroll can do a payout if the contract permits, otherwise the options are advance PTO or unpaid. Since blackout is in effect, we can tag the two days as "Conversion Accommodation" so they bypass blackout if manager approves. Jordan, please confirm manager sign-off here.
Jordan Morales: Confirmed  I approve the accommodation for Dec 28-29. Sasha prefers to avoid payout and keep paid time.
Suki (Payroll): Ok noted. Payroll process: 1) If People Ops flags the accommodation and confirms the 5-day transition credit, Payroll will post 2 days from the credit to cover Dec 28-29. 2) For the remaining 3 contractor days: if company policy requires payout, Payroll will issue a one-time taxable payout on next cycle; otherwise, we can process an advance PTO for up to 5 days (repay via future accrual over 2 months) if Sasha signs the advance agreement. Need written employee preference.
Jordan Morales: Sasha chooses advance PTO for the remaining 3 days and will sign the repayment agreement.
Aisha (People Ops): Great. Process checklist: - Manager approval (done) - Employee signs Advance PTO agreement and indicates repayment timeline (attach to ticket) - People Ops will mark the two Dec days as "Conversion Accommodation" to bypass blackout - Payroll will post credit and advance once docs received.
Suki (Payroll): Also a quick tax/legal flag  for payouts vs advances, different withholding may apply. Priya (People Ops) please loop Legal if Sasha is outside the US or has cross-border pay elements.
Priya (People Ops): Sasha is US-based. No cross-border concerns. Ill add an audit note to the accommodation record so we avoid inconsistent precedents.
HR-Bot: Ticket HR-2026-3017 created for Sasha / Jordan Morales  attach signed advance agreement and conversion offer letter.
Jordan Morales: Will upload Sashas signed advance form and the offer letter today. Thanks all for the quick help.
Suki (Payroll): Once we have docs expect processing in 2 business days. Well cc Jordan and Sasha on the payroll update.
Aisha (People Ops): Closing loop once payroll confirms posting. Welcome Sasha to full-time! :tada:
